fullPassage: In general industry, there are indeed neutral industries, that is, industries without ideological tendencies. For example, the brick-and-tile industry only produces bricks and tiles based on supply and demand. What kind of bricks and tiles do customers want? What kind of bricks are we producing? Regardless of whether these bricks are for the construction of urban houses or rural houses, if the quality is acceptable, then the buyer will accept the price. Another example is the down jacket industry, which is to keep people warm. If the quality, styles, and colours are what customers want, then it does not matter what their occupation is and whether their income is high or low or whether they are old or young. All that matters for them is that the quality, styles, and colours are good. Therefore, we can call the general industry a neutral industry because the products themselves have no ideological bias.

questions.passage: In general industry, there are indeed neutral industries, that is, industries without ideological tendencies. For example, <u>the</u> brick-and-tile industry only produces bricks and tiles based on supply and demand. What kind of bricks and tiles do customers want? What kind of bricks are we producing? Regardless of whether these bricks are for the construction of urban houses or rural houses, if the quality is acceptable, then the buyer will accept the price. Another example is the down jacket industry, which is to keep people warm. If the quality, styles, and colours are what customers want, then it does not matter what their occupation is and whether their income is high or low or whether they are old or young. All that matters for them is that the quality, styles, and colours are good. Therefore, we can call the general industry a neutral industry because the products themselves have no ideological bias.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>the products themselves have no ideological bias</u>이(가) 다음 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 결론 문장이 본문 전체와 어떻게 연결되는지 맥락에서 해석한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 본문은 가격이 이념이 아닌 품질에 따라 결정된다고 함
❌ ② 본문은 오히려 생산자의 이념이 제품에 담기지 않는다는 쪽임
❌ ③ 이념과 고객 확보를 연결 짓는 서술은 본문에 없음
✅ ④ 제품 자체에 이념이 없어 구매가 품질·수요 중심으로 이뤄진다는 본문 요지와 일치 ←정답
